title: Golden Harvest Glow

diffuser.notes: Use in a cool-mist diffuser for 30-minute intervals.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist around room.

why_it_works: Warm, spicy-sweet notes of orange, cinnamon, and clove evoke cozy autumn comfort, while cedarwood adds grounding depth—perfect for crisp evenings.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
Cinnamon and clove are skin sensitizers—use with caution and low dilution.
